Restaurant Style Dal Tadka Recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Sunday, May 20, 2018 - 11:04pm

Ingredients




1cup masoor dal
I onion finely chopped
1 tomatoes finely chopped
1 teaspoon Ginger minced
1 teaspoon garlic minced
1/4 teaspoon turmeric
Salt
1 tbsp ghee
1/2 teaspoon cumin
2 dry chilies
1 tablespoon ginger julienne
3 garlic cloves crushed
1 teaspoon Hing
Curry leaves
Coriander fresh
2 cup water

Preparation

1 In the cooker add masoor dal, chopped onion, chopped tomato, grated ginger and garlic, salt, turmeric powder, water and mix them together. 2 Cook them at least for 3 whistles. 3 For Tempering: – To the small pan add ghee, cumin seeds, chopped ginger, garlic pods, curry leaves, dry red chili, asafoetida and mix them together for 1 minute. 4 Masoor dal tadka is ready to serve with hot steamed rice.

About

The Recipe which gives a kick to your Normal Dal, and makes more dynamic and gives beautiful flavor and aroma to your dial “Dal Tadka”.  Here are Great Tips and Ideas for Restaurant Style Dal Tadka Recipe. Dal Tadka is cooked with Toor dal, tomatoes and with Indian spices and Herbs. Dal Tadka Recipe or Dal Fry recipe is a simple and all-time favorite found in every restaurant and is loved by all since it is easy to prepare and can be enjoyed with roti or rice. It’s a Great Indian foodto make at home with minimal stuff.
